text_block_list.text:
I've been so absorbed in my work that I
lose track
of time. As I rush back home, I
run into someone
familiar...

Oh? What are you still doing here,
Тренер?
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ
choice_data_list:
Don't tell me you've been out here training this
whole time.

text_block_list.text:
I just can't stop thinking about the race...
I
thought running would take my mind
off of it.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
But... no such luck. I'm not sure what else
to try...
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
She seems exhausted from her race... It
might be
time to adjust her schedule so
she can take a
break.
